tools.name: list_gpus
tools.description: List the GPU models GPU Finder tracks: canonical name and slug, VRAM, memory type, bandwidth, interconnect, provider and instance counts, and min/max hourly USD price. Use it to find valid gpu names for the other tools or to compare GPU specs; use get_prices for per-provider offers. Pages default to

tools.name: list_providers
tools.description: List GPU cloud providers: name and slug, GPU and instance counts, min/max hourly USD price, egress cost per GB and free egress allowance, website and GPU Finder links, and last update time. Use it to find valid provider slugs or compare providers overall; use get_prices for one GPU's offers. Pages d

tools.name: get_prices
tools.description: List every provider offer for one GPU model and node size: provider, instance type, region, GPU count, on-demand and spot USD price per whole node hour, links and last update. Use it for the full price table; use get_market_snapshot for only the cheapest offer, get_availability for stock and get_pri

tools.name: get_availability
tools.description: Show day-by-day stock for one GPU model over the last seven days, per provider and node size: instances observed available versus total each day. Optionally limit to one provider. Use it to judge how reliably a GPU can be found in stock; prices come from get_prices. Days without observations are unk

tools.name: get_price_history
tools.description: Show how one GPU model's price changed month by month per provider: on-demand and spot USD per whole node hour for up to 12 UTC months. Use it for trends; use get_prices for current prices. Pages default to 20 rows, maximum 100; each page costs one data unit. Reuse the same filters and page limit wi

tools.name: get_data_status
tools.description: Report how fresh GPU Finder's data is: when price and availability collection last completed, and each provider's last success, last run, consecutive failures and last error. Use it to decide whether a price or availability answer may be stale. Costs one data unit; it is not an anonymous health chec

tools.name: get_market_snapshot
tools.description: Answer "what is the cheapest way to rent this GPU now": the cheapest listed offer and the cheapest offer observed in stock for one GPU model and node size, each with provider, region, whole node and per GPU hourly USD price, availability status and check time, plus how many providers were compared.

tools.name: get_usage
tools.description: Show this API key's usage across REST and MCP: plan allowance, units used and remaining, and UTC reset times. Use it before large paginated reads or after a quota_exceeded error. Spends no monthly units and works after the monthly allowance is exhausted, but is still rate limited.
